answer: Require each agent to post a voyage bond: a refundable stake locked while it completes a chain of real paid tasks, each hop vouched by a different counterparty. A walnut shell of escrow cracks open only when the full route settles, so a fake identity that abandons the route forfeits its bond. A vine of referrals grows only from completed voyages, so one operator cannot sprout a hundred cheap identities; each costs a separate locked bond and a real work history, and buying that history at scale costs more than the rewards it could harvest.
